title: Message Action Completeness QA
principle: Every assistant answer should have useful local-first follow-through: copy, retry, save, fork, safe share and next step.
public_repo_rule: Public-safe QA only. The report stores no user prompts, raw responses, provider keys, secrets, billing configuration or private telemetry.

actions.expected: Copies the assistant answer locally and shows review-before-pasting feedback.
Retries the same prompt with the same safe routing rules when retry context exists.
evidence: Retrying with the same local/private routing rules.

actions.expected: Saves the current transcript into browser-local conversation storage and opens the conversation manager.
Creates a new local branch ending at the selected answer and refreshes the transcript to that fork.
Builds a redacted local share draft, copies it when allowed and opens the Safe Sharing surface.
Opens the most useful next surface: free model picker before live routes, or save/workspace follow-up after useful answers.
evidence: Add memory, knowledge or a workflow next.

storage_contract: Saved conversations stay in browser-local workspace storage.
Safe share drafts are redacted before local copy/storage.
Public dashboard evidence never includes raw user prompts or raw model responses.
